method: An AI agent (Claude Code) read the published store and wrote these claims offline, on the weekly cadence; the live site calls no model, so the marginal cost is zero. disclaimer: DERIVED — what an AI said about the cited facts. Every claim traces to a layer; co-occurrence is association, never causation.
